short_line_policy: Degree min(2,n-1) least-squares polynomial over the available line; one cell has zero derivatives. Inactive and mixed derivatives are exactly zero.
retained_policy: Five-point filter and nearest-interior extrapolation are unchanged for lines of at least five cells and existing 2D controls.
comparison: Independent Q1 and polynomial/stencil derivatives plus G at centers/faces. All output bytes match actual one/four-thread teams in strict and optimized profiles.
